0.long_answer: In diabetic nephropathy, damage to the glomeruli can lead to massive protein loss in the urine (proteinuria), which in turn causes a drop in serum albumin levels. This loss of albumin disrupts the oncotic pressure balance, resulting in an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the interstitial tissues throughout the body. The severe, generalized fluid retention associated with this condition is medically referred to as anasarca.
